common.offline: You're offline. Changes won't be saved until you're back online.

net.waking_body: It can take up to a minute. Please keep this screen open.
net.unreachable_body: Check your internet connection and try again.
net.unexpected_generic: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again in a few minutes.

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Business management panel
login.forgot_help: Forgot your password? Ask an administrator to reset it.

session.ended: Your session has ended. Please log in again.
session.password_changed: Password changed. Please log in again.

home.title: Home
home.empty: The business summary will appear here. Meanwhile, start with the product catalog.

products.title: Products
products.empty_body: Create the first one so you can record purchases and build combos.
products.no_results_body: Try another word or check the filters. Search is accent-sensitive: "azucar" won't find "Azúcar".
products.name: Name
products.name_help: Include the size if it matters: "Sunflower oil 1 L".
products.sku_help: Unique internal code. Letters, numbers, dot, hyphen and underscore.
products.category_help: The type comes from the category and decides which details are needed.
products.unit_help: How this product's stock is counted.
products.min_stock_help: We'll warn you when available stock reaches this amount. 0 = no warning.
products.sale_price_help: A guide only. The actual price is set by each combo or order.
products.stock_new_note: Stock starts at 0 and is updated by purchases and sales.
products.audit: Created by {{createdBy}} on {{createdAt}} · Last changed by {{updatedBy}} on {{updatedAt}}
products.discard_body: What you typed for this product won't be saved.
products.version_conflict_title: Someone else changed this product while you were editing
products.version_conflict_body: Your changes weren't saved. Reload to see the current version and apply them again.
products.status_text_active: Active: can be used in purchases, combos and orders.
products.status_text_inactive: Inactive: can't be used in new purchases, combos or orders.
products.deactivate_body: It can't be used in new purchases, combos or orders. Existing records don't change. You can activate it again at any time.
products.deactivate_stock: It still has stock: {{onHand}} on hand and {{reserved}} reserved.
products.type_change_attrs: This type doesn't use model or warranty: they won't be saved.
products.type_change_unit: The unit changes to "{{unit}}": {{type}} is counted in pieces.
products.model_help: As shown on the box or label: "RC-18".
products.warranty_help: In months, from 0 to 120. For information only: shown when selling.

product.sku_pattern: Use only unaccented letters, numbers, dot (.), hyphen (-) or underscore (_).
product.price_format: Enter a number of 0 or more, with up to 2 decimals.
product.min_stock_format: Enter a number of 0 or more, with up to 3 decimals.
product.warranty_format: Enter a whole number from 0 to 120.

forbidden.title: You don't have access to this page
forbidden.body: Only an administrator can view this page. If you need it, ask one.

categories.title: Categories
categories.intro: Organize the catalog into categories and subcategories (up to 3 levels). The main category's type decides which details each product needs.
categories.max_level_note: Last level: it can't have subcategories.
categories.inactive_note: Inactive: activate it to add subcategories.
categories.parent_help: Only active categories from levels 1 and 2 are listed: 3 levels is the maximum.
categories.type_help: Decides which details each product needs. It can't be changed later.
categories.name_en_help: If left empty, the Spanish name is shown in English.
categories.rename_note: It can't be moved to another category or change its type.
categories.similar_warning: Looks like "{{name}}", which already exists here. If it's the same one, don't create it again.
categories.version_conflict_title: Someone else changed this category while you were editing
categories.version_conflict_body: Your change wasn't saved. Reload to see the current name and try again.
categories.deactivate_body: It can't be chosen for new products or when changing a product's category. Products that already have it keep it. You can activate it again at any time.
categories.blocked_parent_body: A subcategory can't be active while its parent category is inactive.

category.name_conflict_root: There's already a main category called "{{name}}".
category.max_depth: It can't be created here: 3 levels is the maximum. Choose another parent category.
category.parent_inactive: The parent category is inactive. Activate it first or choose another one.
category.has_active_children: It has active subcategories. Deactivate them first.
category.inactive: This category has been deactivated. Choose another one.
